title: Decision-Theoretic MoA: a synthetic falsification study
status: local protocol fixed before first experiment run; not externally preregistered
primary_metric: mean terminal decision loss + lambda * normalized acquisition cost + mu * normalized batch critical-path latency
inference: No LLM endpoint calls. Bernoulli observation channels only; no textual debate or product runtime is emulated.
statistics: paired replicate-level t confidence intervals; exact finite-support expected risks as Monte Carlo checks; Holm correction for four primary comparisons
reporting: Retain negative findings; distinguish theoretical oracle from fitted policies, normalized latency from measured wall time, and simulated channels from real models.
